description: Theres no time to waste in this short life 🥂 #ShowMeHowGoodItCanGet #SoftAndAligned #luxurylife #TheInnerPour
transcript: I no longer fret over making choices and decisions, there are ample opportunities and solutions for every situation, and within knowing that, I have the ability and the skills to make a choice and stick with it, and it doesn't matter what choice that I make. Over that time, I can be flexible and readjust as necessary and as needed, but I don't allow myself to sit in a space where I'm having decision fatigue, because rather I make a decision or not, one will be made for me by the external world, and I no longer allow the external world that much power and control over my life. I am in full control and my hands are on the wheel.
